sloka: नहि कोपपरीतानि हर्षपर्युत्सुकानि च ।भवन्ति युधि योधानां मुखानि निहते पतौ ।। ६.४८.२५ ।।।।
transliteration: nahi kopaparītāni harṣaparyutsukāni ca ।bhavanti yudhi yodhānāṁ mukhāni nihate patau ।। 6.48.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "Vaidehi! Indeed, this aerial car called Pushpaka which is an auspicious one would not have brought you if they are ceased of life."
